summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (legacy-Windows-guarded output assertion), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run, per instructions, and mypy was not run. Nothing was committed.
